newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland's Outokumpu to enhance Norilsk cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Finland's Outokumpu to enhance Norilsk cooperation.

text.p: Finnish metals and mining group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had agreed on closer cooperation with Russian nickel producer Norilsk Nickel.

"The agreement covers metal and technology trade, technology and production cooperation as well as principles for financing trade between the two groups and target programmes for the coming years," it said.
Outokumpu said trade between the groups which signed their previous cooperation agreement in 1993 had increased in recent years and that there was still large growth potential.
"The area of cooperation is expected to expand in the future and possibilities for cooperation are investigated in the areas of mining and metal refining, primarily in Russia and Finland," it said.
The two companies were also looking at opportunities in the commercialisation of jointly developed technology, it said.
